title: Garrison / Control plane
description: Control-plane replicas, leadership, heartbeats, the event backplane, process pauses, and every background service iteration.

list.name: node
list.label: Node
list.description: Garrison node: the server pod or container name, or the worker node name.

list.name: window
list.label: Average over
list.description: Window for rates, averages, and percentiles. Runs are infrequent, so short windows leave gaps.

panels.title: Replicas Ready
panels.description: Control-plane replicas in Ready, cluster-wide.

panels.title: Leader
panels.description: 1 when a replica holds leadership.

panels.title: Leader changes
panels.description: Leadership acquired or lost in the selected range.

panels.title: Heartbeat errors
panels.description: Control node heartbeats that failed to write.

panels.title: Pauses
panels.description: Process pauses detected by maintenance.

panels.title: Background errors
panels.description: Background iterations that failed in the selected range.

panels.title: Replicas by status
panels.description: Control-plane replicas by status (aggregate with max: every replica reports the same counts).

panels.title: Leader by replica
panels.description: Which replica holds leadership.

panels.title: Leadership changes
panels.description: Leadership acquired or lost, by replica.

targets.expr: sum by (node, role) (increase(garrison_leader_changes_total{node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "node", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Control node heartbeats (per minute)
panels.description: This replica's heartbeats by result.

targets.expr: sum by (node, result) (rate(garrison_control_node_heartbeats_total{node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60 or on() label_replace(vector(0), "node", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Control node transitions
panels.description: Replica state transitions by new status (Starting, Ready, Draining, Offline).

panels.title: Maintenance pauses
panels.description: Process pauses detected, by whether the replica was leader.

panels.title: Backplane messages published (per minute)
panels.description: Messages published by kind.

targets.expr: sum by (backplane, kind) (rate(garrison_backplane_published_total{node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60 or on() label_replace(vector(0), "backplane", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Backplane messages received (per minute)
panels.description: Messages received from other replicas by kind.

targets.expr: sum by (backplane, kind) (rate(garrison_backplane_received_total{node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60 or on() label_replace(vector(0), "backplane", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Backplane lag
panels.description: Publish on one replica to delivery on another.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, backplane) (rate(garrison_backplane_lag_seconds_bucket{node=~"$node"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "backplane", "none", "", "")
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, backplane) (rate(garrison_backplane_lag_seconds_bucket{node=~"$node"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "backplane", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Background iterations by service and result (per minute)
panels.description: Iterations of every background service (maintenance steps, leader election, gauges, retention, settings refresh, backplane, worker heartbeat and lease loops) by result: ok, idle, error.

targets.expr: sum by (service, operation, result) (rate(garrison_background_iterations_total{node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60 or on() label_replace(vector(0), "service", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Background iteration p95 by operation
panels.description: 95th percentile iteration duration by service and operation.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service, operation) (rate(garrison_background_duration_seconds_bucket{node=~"$node"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "service", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Background services
panels.description: Iterations, errors, and 95th percentile duration per service and operation over the selected range.

panels.title: Process memory
panels.description: .NET working set per process.

panels.title: Thread pool queue
panels.description: .NET thread pool queue length per process; a growing queue means the process is saturated.

panels.title: Failed or slow background iterations
panels.description: Background iteration spans that ended in an error or took longer than 50 ms.

panels.title: Control plane logs
panels.description: Leader, control node, backplane, maintenance, and server lifecycle lines.
